replication.target_description: Single empirical study: sequential indirect relationship closeness → desire to maintain the relationship → motivated reasoning questionnaire items → interpersonal forgiveness, Table 2 panel b. Locator also admits a distinct thought-negativity operationalization in panel a; exact intended row is not identified.

notes:
Original acquisition: DOI landing page inaccessible; Unpaywall and OpenAlex returned no open-access location; author-hosted USC PDF had an expired TLS certificate and returned 404 after certificate handling; web retrieval also failed. No full original paper available. Replication title verified against assigned reference. Table 2 prints bootstrap confidence intervals, not p-values: no p inferred from a confidence interval. Selected panel b questionnaire sequential indirect effect because it operationalizes all four constructs in the supplied description and is explicitly described as replicating the original measure; panel a thought-negativity sequential indirect effect is separately printed as 0.36 (SE 0.21, 95% CI 0.06 to 0.88). Panel b has SE 0.32 and 95% CI 0.68 to 1.93. Exact target row remains ambiguous, so target_match is null. Recruited N is 107, but no explicit analytic N for the target mediation was established; n.value remains null.
Source follow-up: The named Donovan and Priester primary article is available. PDF p.6/Table 2 reports Study 1 with several distinct direct and indirect paths, while the neutral description also includes relationship closeness, introduced in Study 2. No individual path or study is identified. Cannot select one beta or attach a same-test p without guessing. Unassigned replication side not examined.
